component.name: Note Note
component.summary: Edit local Markdown notes and connected notebooks

description.p: Note Note brings local Markdown notebooks, Microsoft OneNote, Sticky Notes, and Notion into one workspace. Local notebooks work without an account.
Organize notebooks in tabs, search notes, and edit rich text with Markdown storage. The application follows available desktop colors and saves changes before closing.

screenshot.caption: Notebook tabs, note list, and rich text editing

description.p: The editing tools stay on one horizontally scrollable row in narrow windows, with Insert fixed on the right. Notebook tabs and workspace controls have refined rounded shapes, and the status bar has a larger left-panel icon for showing or hiding the sidebar.
Fix bold text returning after saving and reopening a note. Turning Bold off now saves regular text while keeping other inline formatting.
Fix notes remaining Unsaved when an indented line contains pasted inline code or other formatting. Tabs and leading spaces now preserve prose indentation and formatting when the note is saved.

OneNote discovers shared notebook links and resumes notebook and page discovery after a restart or request-budget pause, keeping capacity available for opening and saving notes. An unused local notes folder starts with a Getting started note, and light themes have clearer text and active tabs.

Images now have a small, consistent gap before the following text, regardless of their size. The title bar and notebook header share the sidebar surface, while the formatting toolbar matches the editor.

The editing toolbar offers only the tools that apply where the caret is. Inside a code block the text styles, text color, highlight, link, headings, lists, indent and quote are hidden, instead of typing Markdown markers into the code; in a table cell the heading, indent, outdent, quote and code block tools are hidden.
The note's scrollbar sits just beside the note instead of over its right edge, so it no longer covers text or code blocks.

Plugins can add editing-toolbar tools that insert or format text in the note; the Insert month tools now come from the built-in calendar plugin. Tool popups such as Insert link and Insert custom month are lighter: a small header, fields without labels above them, and a footer with the key hint beside one Insert button. Escape or a click outside cancels.
The note's scrollbar stays visible whenever the note is longer than the window, not only while the mouse is over it, and a note that fits shows none.

Undo puts the cursor back where the edit began: undoing a paste, a highlight, a color, a list or a block tool no longer jumps to the top or the end of the note. Ctrl+Y now redoes on Linux desktops too.
Fix undo moving the cursor back toward a table after editing text below it. Table formatting now initializes when the note loads.

Review fixes since 1.0.21. The status bar's sidebar toggle is quiet until hovered and the status message shows the link under the pointer. OneNote refuses a save that would flatten formatting and keeps sections in their owner's order; a Notion page opens for editing only when a save can put it back; a cut Sticky note opens read-only. Pasting says why it did nothing, headings four to six survive the editor, and every network response is read through one bounded, deadline-aware reader.
Local Markdown notebooks, OneNote, Sticky Notes and Notion in one workspace, available as a Linux app and an Omarchy plugin.
Switch directly to notebook tabs with Alt+1 through Alt+9.
Add the standalone Qt application, system colors, and safe shutdown while background reads are active.
